name: host_epoch
meaning: mov r14,[rsi+0x3888]: active epoch word, Staking +0x48

name: host_listed_lookup
meaning: call 0x13a9c60: signer in the listed set

name: host_refuse
meaning: mov word [r15],0x91: neither listed nor validator

name: host_tag_shift
meaning: lea rcx,[rax-0x12]: raw tag to index

name: host_fast_byte
meaning: cmp byte [rax+8],1: index 0x4a only with this byte

name: host_tracker
meaning: add rax,0x3510: vote tracker in the Exchange

name: host_vote_plain
meaning: call 0x1eac160: vote with the static set

name: host_vote_cloned
meaning: call 0x1eabf10: vote with a clone of the static set

name: host_pop_plain
meaning: call 0x2329770: row pop after a pass

name: host_pop_cloned
meaning: call 0x1eabe10: row pop with a clone

name: host_none
meaning: cmp dword result,0x74: 0x74 means no pass

name: tally_id_flag
meaning: test byte [rcx],1: voter has a validator key

name: tally_vote_value
meaning: add rbx,0xa50: votes value area of the node

name: tally_before
meaning: call 0x2329610: quorum before the new vote

name: tally_after
meaning: call 0x2329610: quorum after the new vote

name: quorum_stake
meaning: call 0x3366b60: stake quorum on the validator keys

name: listed_compare
meaning: cmp r10,[rsi+0x18]: counted members against the static word

name: class_inline
meaning: mov eax,0x14: word below 0x74 is VoteGlobal, index 20

name: gate_class_two
meaning: cmp cl,2: classes 0 and 1 share an arm

name: gate_listed_bit
meaning: test bpl,1: class 1 falls to the listed set
